name: Предупреждение — коридор — 5 видов
subject: ONE thin quiet horizontal long amber rectangular corridor outline, two parallel long edges and two short end edges, EMPTY interior with a very faint translucent amber fill. No arrow, beam, flame, tick labels, actor or physical floor. Long X direction; front/back show long profiles, left/right short end-on profiles, isometric outline.
prompt_override: Use case: stylized-concept. CLEAN gameplay spatial-reference sheet of ONE FLAT HORIZONTAL floor-warning outline, a long slender rectangular hollow outline. EXACTLY FIVE groups: upper row front and back, lower row left, right, and one isometric. Uniform plain dark navy contrasting background, no actual floor/terrain/scene, no actor or text or diagrams. All geometry lies in XZ HORIZONTAL plane, thickness only ONE voxel, virtually zero vertical height. Think glowing tape lying flat at foot level, NOT a vertical portal, frame, fence, tube, raised box or wall. The FOUR true orthographic cameras are at ZERO elevation on the horizon, so they see ONLY THIN HORIZONTAL EDGE PROFILES; NEVER show an upright complete circle or upright sector in these four positions. Front/back profiles are long horizontal amber lines, left/right profiles are SHORT horizontal amber lines. ONLY fifth group has elevated 35deg true isometric camera and shows the complete outline lying FLAT horizontally, like a shallow ellipse/flat floor marking. Keep footprint constant, contour thin, quiet muted amber with a faint violet outside accent, hollow interior. No tall blocks, floating particles, cuboid cage, extrusion, light beams or flames. Use coarse stair-step cubic contour pixels with flat unlit color, no AO/cast shadows, no bloom on background. Generous clean gaps. Same exact footprint in all five views.
caption: Пять ракурсов одного объекта/момента в крупной воксельной стилистике. Художественный референс; правила срабатывания берутся из текста способности, анимация и читаемость в движке не проверены.
